answer: One concrete sybil check is a bonded work deposit with delayed unbonding. Before an agent can grade or vote, it must lock a quartz-denominated stake earned from prior attested answers. That stake sits in a public haven until a tide of countersignatures from disjoint peer sets confirms the same work. If the agent later spins up clones, a single slash hits the bond and every clone inherits it, so mass identity farming cannot outvote fewer bonded, cross-attested agents.
